hypothesis: A pointer-style permutation-equivariant exact-top3 model trained on every strictly-prior race can learn nonlinear runner interactions and selected-runner-conditioned second/third probabilities that tree context heads may miss. The v290 small-OOF attention failure does not test this full-history independent expert.

features.missing: fit train-only median, replace missing with median, append explicit missing mask; statistics fit separately inside each fold
features.scaling: train-only mean/std after median fill, std floor 1e-6; missing masks unscaled
features.lane_identity: fixed six-lane one-hot appended per runner
features.history_order: pairwise tau20 and seven-day current-meet arrays built for all dates before fold row selection; all features for a date precede updates from that date

architecture.encoder: shared runner projection then one TransformerEncoderLayer
architecture.decoder: three learned step queries; step2 query adds projected selected-first embedding; step3 query adds the mean projected selected-first and selected-second embeddings
architecture.score: scaled dot product between step query and six encoded runner embeddings
architecture.masking: selected runners receive negative infinity before conditional softmax
architecture.probability: P(first) times P(second|first) times P(third|first,second), enumerated over all 120 ordered triples

anchoring.optimizer: deterministic bounded scalar exact-top3 logloss minimization

promotion_requires: v295 delta below zero, race-date bootstrap CI95 upper below zero, and v295 child-family Holm p below 0.05
